display.purpose: Page title and brand wordmark. Solid ink, never gradient.

data.purpose: Monospace score and count values in stat cards.

mono.purpose: URLs, file names, code previews, progress-log lines.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth comes from the tonal ramp + 1px borders.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: 2px cyan :focus-visible ring with a canvas-colored offset gap.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color shifts).

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Hover/active feedback on buttons and cards.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, transitions collapse to instant / crossfade.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action (Analyze). Solid cyan, never gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00d9ff; color: #0d1117; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2bb8d9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1f9fbf; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0d1117, 0 0 0 4px #00d9ff; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #21262d; color: #6e7681; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Repo URL Input
components.description: Monospace field holding a repository URL. Flat canvas ground, hairline border, cyan focus.
components.css: .ds-input-url { width: 100%; background: #0d1117; color: #e6edf3; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #30363d; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); } .ds-input-url::placeholder { color: #8b949e; } .ds-input-url:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #00d9ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,217,255,0.25); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input-url { transition: none; } }

components.name: Progress Log Line
components.description: One honest, streamed status line. Phase = cyan, success = green, error = red, step = muted.
components.html:
▶ Cloning repository
Scanned 45 files
✓ Analysis complete
components.css: .ds-log { background: #161b22; border: 1px solid #30363d; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-log-line { padding: 4px 0; } .ds-log-line.is-phase { color: #00d9ff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-log-line.is-step { color: #8b949e; } .ds-log-line.is-success { color: #3fb950; } .ds-log-line.is-error { color: #f85149; }

narrative.overview: Repo Bootcamp is a tool that lives in the terminal; its web surface should feel like the calmest, clearest console a developer has ever read. The system is anchored on GitHub's own dark canvas and Primer-dark surface ramp because the audience already trusts that environment. Data is monospace, status is streamed and honest, and one confident cyan is the single signal color spent only on what the user acts on or waits for. It rejects the saturated AI dark-mode look the project shipped with: the navy gradient ground, the cyan-to-green gradient wordmark and button, and washed-out #888 text.
keyCharacteristics: GitHub Primer-dark surface ramp (canvas → surface → surface-raised) as the identity anchor
One committed cyan accent, used solid for primary action / focus / active only
Monospace for code, paths, URLs, and scores; sans for human prose
Flat by default — depth via tonal layers and 1px borders, no decorative shadows
Honest streamed status as the signature interaction

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan appears on ≤10% of any screen. If two things are cyan at once, one is wrong. Scores use the semantic set, not the accent.

rules.name: The Earned-Dark Rule
rules.body: The dark ground is GitHub's flat #0d1117, never the #1a1a2e → #16213e navy gradient or any tinted-navy body.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Machines Rule
rules.body: Paths, URLs, scores, grades, and generated content are monospace; sentences written for humans are sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and bordered at rest; the only depth that moves is focus (a ring) and hover (a one-step tonal shift).

dos: Do anchor on the GitHub Primer-dark ramp and convey depth with tonal layers + 1px borders
Do keep one committed cyan accent, solid, for primary action / focus / active only
Do set monospace for repo URLs, file names, scores, and code previews
Do give every control all states and keep transitions 150–250ms
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with a non-animated fallback
Do keep body prose at 65–75ch, #e6edf3 primary text, #8b949e muted floor
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) on the wordmark or anywhere
Don't fill the primary button with the cyan-to-green gradient; use a single solid accent
Don't reintroduce the navy gradient background (#1a1a2e → #16213e) or any tinted-navy ground
Don't use #888 or lighter gray for text on dark; #8b949e is the floor, body prefers #e6edf3
Don't make transform: scale(1.05) the button's hover feedback; shift background/border instead
Don't reach for glassmorphism, backdrop blur, the hero-metric template, or per-section uppercase eyebrows
